BiblicalUsage: Ishod was a son of Hammoleketh, named in the families of Manasseh. In 1 Chronicles 7:18 his sister Hammoleketh bare Ishod, and Abiezer, and Mahalah.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Ishod's one verse is the family record: a son of Manasseh, named with his brother and sister, in the tribe's genealogy.
